name: Coral
verdict: Owned by Entain plc, a London-listed betting and gaming group. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Entain plc is listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange. Its Annual Report 2024 (Substantial shareholdings) lists the holdings notified to it as at 21 February 2025: The Capital Group Companies 10.46%, Dodge & Cox 9.87%, BlackRock 7.20%, Eminence Capital 6.44%, Corvex Capital 5.32%, Janus Henderson 4.62% and Vanguard 4.24%; none is a state or state fund, so nothing passes the test. Entain's regulatory history (UK Gambling Commission penalties; the December 2023 DPA with the CPS over legacy Turkish bribery) is a financial/bribery/consumer record and does not count (METHOD.md). Coral's Birmingham City shirt deal began in 2026/27, the brand's first front-of-shirt partnership.
